_readme: Optional extra details for calendar events, keyed by the Google Calendar event id from src/data/events.json. events.json is rewritten by the daily calendar sync, so put hand-written details here instead. Anything filled in here is used for the event's Google structured data (JSON-LD). Fields: name, description, startTime/endTime (24h HH:MM, Arizona time; an endTime earlier than startTime means after midnight), url, image (site path or full URL), performers (list of { name, role, url }).
